fixes: (A) All mobile card titles are now the same size as the Videos ('Preview the Boom') title. Cause: the active card kept clamp(34px,11vw,50px) via .card3d.is-active .card-title (0,2,0) while non-active titles fell back to 32px; the Locations title is an <h2 class='card-title'> pinned to 32px by .card3d[data-wall-pos] .card-locations h2 (0,3,1). New phone-only selectors tie/beat both, unifying every title at ~42.9px (390px viewport).

(B) Tightened the empty space above and below the bottom countdown on mobile: gap above the Social Feed card 64px -> 34px (still clears the card glow, no overlap), gap below before the footer 34px -> 14px, so the timeclock no longer floats in dead space.
